page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Above: running head "CONCIONES" with page number "262" at the top left. Then the heading "CONCIO XLI." and the reference "Matt. 5." Below these, the Scripture passage in italic with a woodcut initial, followed by the commentary paragraphs in roman. Catchword "mi" at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: CONCIO XLI.
Matt. 5.

p.i: Audistis[?] quod dictum fuerit antiquis, Non committes adulterium. At ego dico vobis, quod quicunque aspexerit uxorem alterius ad concupiscendum eam, iam adulterium cum ea commisit in corde suo. Quod si oculus tuus dexter offendiculo tibi fuerit, erue illum, & abijce abs te. Expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, ac non totum corpus tuum conijciatur in gehennam. Et si dextera tua manus offenderit tibi, amputa eam, & proijce abs te. Expedit enim, ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, ac non totum corpus tuum conijciatur in gehennam.

main_text.p: I Scopus horum verborum est, Christum Dominum usque adeo non tollere legem Dei suam doctrina, ut illam magis adimpleat, perfectioremque a suis iustitiam exigat, quam fuerit Scribarum & Pharisaeorum: idque declarat iam exemplo de adulterando, ut prius de occidendo. page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "Audistis" is an ornamental block; the first letter is likely A, marked [?]. The printed text in the scripture passage reads "Vdistis" in the italic type, so the initial is shown as "Audistis" after u/v normalisation. Probable printing errors left as printed: "quodquicunque" printed without a space (rendered "quod quicunque"); "conijciatur" and "proijce" with i as printed. Running head and page number are as printed. The line-end hyphen in "proxi-" is kept; the catchword "mi" completes the word on the next page.
